verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that messages can be deleted: Gemini can be asked to delete multiple emails, and delegates can delete messages on the user's behalf. Nothing in the pack covers retention policies or user control over how long data is kept. Missing for 10: retention-period or auto-delete settings, account- or data-level deletion controls, control over retention of data processed by AI features, API-level delete/retention documentation, independent corroboration.
